title: fraxinus excelsior var. obliqua
intro: Fraxinus excelsior var. obliqua, commonly known as the ash-leaf maple, is a deciduous tree that is native to Europe. The ash-leaf maple has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of the ash-leaf maple include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe irritated tissues and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of the ash-leaf maple include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
